subject: Cannot Deploy ShinyApp when using ROracle package

messages.author: 0a6f3f1bb089c8d4
messages.subject: Cannot Deploy ShinyApp when using ROracle package
parts:
Hello Everyone,

We are trying to deploy our shiny application. We can connect to Oracle through ROracle locally, but when I am publishing the application I get the below error

Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages: - "ROracle" Execution halted


I was able to install ROracle through 

install.packages("ROracle",type = "source")

library(ROracle)

Please help me out, I need the ShinyApp to load the data from Oracle database.

Thank you
